title: Gestor de RH
description:
Tipo de contrato: Tempo indeterminado

Descrição:
Cargo Gestor de RH Indústria Número de vagas 1 Descrição da função 1. Fluent in English for communication and reporting to management. 2. HR-related major, with solid end-to-end HR practical experience. 3. Stable career history; frequent job-hopping is not preferred. Minimum 2 years tenure in previous employers is a plus. 4. Prior HR experience in FMCG, manufacturing factories, Chinese / foreign-owned production enterprises is preferred. Familiar with Angolan labour law, labour compliance, social security and INEFOP. 5. Proficient in Primavera / SAP HR and Excel; HR data analytics skill is a plus. 6. Experience in independently managing HR functions and leading a team is preferred. Proven quantifiable HR achievements are an advantage. 7. Education: Bachelor’s degree holder is preferred.

Requisitos:
Titulação mínima Licenciatura Experiência exigida 3 Anos Nacionalidade África do Sul, Angola Línguas Português, Inglês, Chinês Area funcional Competências Não definido Aptidões necessárias Oversee full spectrum of local HR operations for the factory: recruitment, contracts & records, attendance & performance management, employee relations and labour dispute resolution. Control manpower cost and prepare HR reports; develop and improve HR policies & processes, manage staff turnover; liaise with local authorities for compliance; lead the HR team and coordinate with other departments.
